title: Women's Low Top Lace Up Sneakers with Leather Lining for Casual Outfits

Adjustable instep fit: The front laces let the wearer loosen the opening for entry and set the tension over the foot.

Leather-lined construction: A genuine leather lining forms the inside contact layer, paired with the closed-front casual upper.
